text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'
        registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo build --release
        npm install --prefix tests/e2e

    - name: Build Tavern frontend
      working-directory: tavern/frontend
      run: npm install && npm run build

    - name: Start Tavern server
      id: start-server
      working-directory: tavern
      run: |
        ./scripts/start_server.sh &
        echo "::set-output name=server_pid::$!"
      env:
        RUST_LOG: info

    - name: Retrieve server public key
      id: get-key
      run: |
        SERVER_PID=$(echo ${{ steps.start-server.outputs.server_pid }})
        sleep 5
        curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/public_key > public_key.pem

    - name: Compile Imixv2 agent
      working-directory: imixv2
      run: make

    - name: Start Imixv2 agent
      working-directory: imixv2
      run: ./imixv2 -key ../public_key.pem &

    - name: Run Playwright tests
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: npx playwright test

    - name: Clean up processes
      run: |
        pkill -P $(pgrep -d',' -f 'tavern')
        pkill -P $(pgrep -d',' -f 'imixv2')

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: tests/e2e/test-results
```
